# Hidden {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-important}
## Internal / facilitator view
This page is intentionally left out of the sidebar navigation. It holds the weekly curriculum
table with **lecture time** per week, for facilitator planning. Reachable only by its direct
URL (`/hidden`).
:::

| Week | Mindset | Big Question | Time |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Mentoring Style | Does my mentoring style focus on structure or support? | 20 min |
| 2 | Motivational Style | Is my motivational approach to promote or prevent for my mentees' academics or social connection? | 5 min |
| 3 | Leadership Focus | Is my leadership style to promote or prevent for the team? | 20 min |
| 4 | Feedback Orientation | Is my feedback preference supportive or corrective? | 5 min |
| 5 | Feedback Purpose | Is my feedback preference developmental or summative? | 10 min |
| 6 | Leadership Role | What is my leadership role? | 5 min |
| 7 | Communication Style | What is my communication style? | 20 min |
| 8 | Inclusive Mentoring | Is my mentoring inclusive? | 5 min |
| 9 | Conflict Style | What is my conflict resolution style? | 30 min |
| 10 | Goal Preference | What is my goal orientation? | 5 min |
| 11 | Facilitator | How will I facilitate my team's discussion with caring communication? | 40 min |
| 12 | People Orientation | What is my view of people? | 20 min |
| 13 | Self-Awareness | What is my self-awareness type? | 15 min |
